source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: A support report describes a familiar broken link, but you cannot establish which of two course sections the sender means. What should the workflow do?

options.text: Repair both sections so that one of the changes will reach the intended target.
options.feedback: Changing both expands the intervention without resolving the target. The workflow first needs to establish the intended section.

options.text: Repair the first section listed because the symptom matches a known case.
options.feedback: A known symptom does not identify the correct course area. Acting on list order risks changing the wrong target.

options.text: Choose the section with the most familiar title and report a verified repair.
options.feedback: A plausible title is not sufficient target evidence. Reporting verification would also be premature before checking the affected result.

options.text: Resolve the section or escalate the ambiguity before repairing.
options.feedback: The repair boundary includes a known target as well as a known procedure. Preserve the collected evidence and escalate if the section remains uncertain.
